facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of gravity energy at CV-3101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3101 and M-3101 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. CV-3101 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 7 March 2005 a near hit was recorded on CV-3101 and M-3101 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
